prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The camera smoothly glides through the dense forest, capturing the intricate details of the snowy path that winds between tall, leafless trees and rocky outcrops. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts slightly upward, revealing the silhouettes of branches against the dimly lit sky, while the soft glow of ambient light casts long shadows across the terrain. The surrounding environment is enveloped in a serene, wintry atmosphere, with the ground blanketed in a layer of fresh snow that crunches subtly underfoot. The camera continues its journey, panning gently to the right to showcase the rugged landscape, where patches of exposed earth peek through the snow. The lighting remains consistent, with a warm, golden hue filtering through the trees, creating a contrast with the cool blue tones of the night. The scene remains empty, devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude and tranquility of the natural setting. As the path curves and descends, the camera captures the undulating terrain, highlighting the textures of the snow and rocks, before coming to a momentary pause, allowing the viewer to absorb the peaceful, untouched beauty of the Mardi Himal Trail at night.
